changeHypothesis.summary: Major Japanese suppliers were reducing legacy standard MLCC capacity while Taiwan/China suppliers repeatedly raised prices. This is a productive-capacity state change that can lead supplier ASP and earnings, but by March 31 the equity basket had already broadly rerated and Fenghua's strongest 2018Q1 earnings confirmation was not yet public.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Supplier product-mix shifts and capacity exits can persist for quarters because qualification and capacity additions take time.
disconfirmingEvidence: All three frozen A-share expressions already beat CSI300 over both 20d and 60d.
Fenghua's provisional trailing multiple was high on cutoff-known 2017 earnings.
The April 10 Fenghua Q1 +300% forecast is post-cutoff and excluded.
